description: The extends preset is pinned to a commit SHA, matching the SHA-pinning discipline .claude/rules/github-actions-security.md imposes on actions: the thing that keeps our action SHAs current is itself pinned, so an edit upstream cannot silently change update policy here. Bump the SHA deliberately.
enabledManagers and automerge are declared here, not inherited, so the external preset cannot silently drop manifest coverage or turn automerge on.

customManagers cover the tool pins no built-in manager reads: `uv run --with <tool>==<version>` in the Makefile, and the PEP 723 inline block in scripts/hooks/*.py. Without them a ruff bump touched pyproject.toml alone and left the Makefile, the hook and the pre-commit rev behind, which tests/test_hooks.py fails by design.

The groupName rules put every call site for one tool in a single PR. ruff on PyPI and astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit are different packages to Renovate, so ungrouped they arrive as separate PRs and each one is a partial bump that fails the same test.

customManagers.description: PEP 723 inline script dependencies in the PostToolUse hooks

packageRules.description: ruff is pinned in four places across three managers; one PR must move them all.
bandit likewise: the pyproject pin and the SHA-pinned pre-commit rev.
